Package com.bupt.ta.service.admin

Class AdminDashboardMetrics

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.admin.AdminDashboardMetrics
public class AdminDashboardMetrics extends Object
Aggregated metrics for the admin dashboard charts and AI analytics briefing.

Populated by AdminMetricsBuilder.build(java.util.List<com.bupt.ta.model.User>, java.util.List<com.bupt.ta.model.Application>, java.util.List<com.bupt.ta.model.Job>, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, com.bupt.ta.model.TaWorkloadStats>) from in-memory lists of users, applications, jobs, and TA workload stats. Not persisted — rebuilt on each GET /admin request.

Public fields are mutable containers filled during build; treat instances as request-scoped snapshots rather than shared long-lived state.

See Also:
  • AdminMetricsBuilder.toChartJson(AdminDashboardMetrics)
